summary: Westport Fuel Systems filed a Form 6-K furnishing a September 14, 2026 press release announcing technical details of HPDI 3.0, the next-generation high-pressure direct injection fuel system from Cespira, its joint venture with Volvo Group. The disclosure covers improved rail-pressure control, durability, integration flexibility, LNG/bioLNG support and a future hydrogen pathway, plus Cespira revenue growth of 125% year over year from Q2 2025 to Q2 2026. No securities, prices, stakes, board recommendations, advisors or transaction mechanics are stated, so this is a routine product/technology update, not a special situation.
